origin: Recraft vectorize (media-studio `media vectorize`, 2026-10-19) of the owner's keycap render, reduced to the two site colours #0a0a0a and #ededed. Texture specks inside the face were dropped and the t redrawn as one stepped polygon measured from the source. The 16 and 32 px favicons are hand-drawn pixel versions because the halftone blurs to grey at that size.
